bullets: snelle spraak, accenten, films en radio zonder moeite volgt

blocks.text: Vul het ontbrekende woord in. De antwoorden staan op de laatste pagina.

items.q: By and ______, the project was a success.
items.full: By and large, the project was a success.

items.q: In the long ______, renewable energy will be cheaper.
items.full: In the long run, renewable energy will be cheaper.

items.q: We'll stay here for the time ______.
items.full: We'll stay here for the time being.

items.q: In a ______, we need more money.
items.full: In a nutshell, we need more money.

items.q: We should never take our health for ______.
items.full: We should never take our health for granted.

items.q: It took him years to come to ______ with his loss.
items.full: It took him years to come to terms with his loss.

items.q: This research sheds ______ on an old mystery.
items.full: This research sheds light on an old mystery.

items.q: She is ______ in her work; she checks every detail.
items.full: She is meticulous in her work; she checks every detail.

items.q: It was, to put it ______, a disappointing result.
items.full: It was, to put it mildly, a disappointing result.

items.q: Over het algemeen was het een succes.
items.a: By and large, it was a success.
For the time being, we'll stay here.

items.q: Houd in gedachten dat het duur is.
items.a: Bear in mind that it is expensive.

items.q: Neem je gezondheid niet als vanzelfsprekend aan.
items.a: Don't take your health for granted.
